title: Common providers: Ireland
coverage: Partial. Covers the national carriers, cable, the mobile network operators and the three wholesale fibre networks; business ISPs and fixed-wireless operators are thin.
missing: AS numbers for SIRO, National Broadband Ireland, Viatel, BT Ireland, Pure Telecom and HEAnet (none confirmed)
Status pages (only one answered a check on the read date)

sources.name: ComReg: Quarterly Key Data Report
sources.terms: The page redirected an automated read on the read date and its terms were not read: nothing is copied.
sources.result: Not read. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in the Republic of Ireland
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 10 of 17 candidate names were found on the page (the 16 entries of version 1.0.0; later entries were not looked up there).

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Ireland
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 7 of 17 candidate names were found on the page (the 16 entries of version 1.0.0; later entries were not looked up there).

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 19 of 20 websites and 1 support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 14 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: eir
providers.notes: eir evo for business; open eir is the wholesale arm.

providers.name: open eir
providers.notes: Wholesale arm of eir; the network (AS5466) is recorded on eir.

providers.name: Virgin Media Ireland
providers.notes: Liberty Global network: it uses AS6830, so where NetBox already holds Liberty Global this entry resolves to it.

providers.name: Sky Ireland
providers.notes: Uses the AS number of Sky (United Kingdom pack): where NetBox already holds Sky, this entry resolves to it.

providers.name: SIRO
providers.notes: Wholesale fibre network (ESB and Vodafone); retail through other providers.

providers.name: National Broadband Ireland
providers.notes: Wholesale fibre network of the National Broadband Plan.

providers.name: Enet
providers.notes: Operates the Metropolitan Area Networks; wholesale.
